parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster that you want to delete.

parameters.name: ReserveNamespace
parameters.description: Specifies whether to reserve the istio-system namespace when you delete the cluster. Valid values: true and false.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh remove-cluster-from-service-mesh --service-mesh-id ce3c25e247da24f3aab9b7edfae830000 --cluster-id cb8963379255149cb98c8686f274x0000 --reserve-namespace false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh RemoveClusterFromServiceMesh --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceMeshId ce3c25e247da24f3aab9b7edfae830000 --ClusterId cb8963379255149cb98c8686f274x0000 --ReserveNamespace false
